sections.label: Book 12
sections.name: The fire altar: the Garhapatya hearth and the Plants

verses.sa: दृशानो रुक्म उर्व्या व्यद्यौद् दुर्मर्षमायुः श्रिये रुचानः। अग्निरमृतो अभवद्वयोभिर्यदेनं द्यौरजनयत्सुरेताः॥
verses.tr: dṛśāno rukma urvyā vyadyaud durmarṣamāyuḥ śriye rucānaḥ agniramṛto abhavadvayobhiryadenaṃ dyaurajanayatsuretāḥ
verses.en: Far hath he be shone abroad like gold to look on, beaming im< imperishable life for glory., Agni by vital powers became immortal when his prolific Father Dyaus begat him.

verses.sa: नक्तोषासा समनसा विरूपे धापयेते शिशुमेकं समीची। द्यावाक्षामा रुक्मो अन्तर्वि भाति देवा अग्निं धारयन्द्रविणोदाः॥
verses.tr: naktoṣāsā samanasā virūpe dhāpayete śiśumekaṃ samīcī dyāvākṣāmā rukmo antarvi bhāti devā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodāḥ
verses.en: Night and Dawn, different in hue, accordant, meeting together, suckle one. same infant. Golden between the heaven and earth he shinfith. The wealth-possessing Gods supported Agtti.

verses.sa: विश्वा रूपाणि प्रति मुञ्चते कविः प्रासावीद्भद्रं द्विपदे चतुष्पदे। वि नाकमख्यत्सविता वरेण्योऽनु प्रयाणमुषसो वि राजति॥
verses.tr: viśvā rūpāṇi prati muñcate kaviḥ prāsāvīdbhadraṃ dvipade catuṣpade vi nākamakhyatsavitā vareṇyo'nu prayāṇamuṣaso vi rājati
verses.en: The Sapient One arrays |himself£ in every form: for, quadruped and biped he hath brought forth good. Excellent Savitar hath looked on. heaven's high vault.: he shineth after the outgoings of the Dawn.

verses.sa: सुपर्णोऽसि गरुत्माँस्त्रिवृत्ते शिरो गायत्रं चक्षुर्बृहद्रथन्तरे पक्षौ। स्तोम आत्मा छन्दांस्यङ्गानि यजूँंषि नाम। साम ते तनूर्वामदेव्यं यज्ञायज्ञियं पुच्छं धिष्ण्याः शपाः। सुपर्णोऽसि गरुत्मान्दिवं गच्छ स्वः पत॥
verses.tr: suparṇo'si garutmāṃstrivṛtte śiro gāyatraṃ cakṣurbṛhadrathantare pakṣau stoma ātmā chandāṃsyaṅgāni yajūṃṃṣi nāma sāma te tanūrvāmadevyaṃ yajñāyajñiyaṃ pucchaṃ dhiṣṇyāḥ śapāḥ suparṇo'si garutmāndivaṃ gaccha svaḥ pata
verses.en: Thou art the goodly-pinioned. Bird: thou hast the Trivrit for thy head. Gayatra is thine eye, thy wings are Brihat and Rathan tara. The hymn is self, the metres are his limbs, the formulas his name. The Vamadevya Sftman is thy form, the Yajfiayjyfiiya thy tail, the fire-hearths are thy hooves. Thou art the goodly-pinioned Bird: go skyward, soar to heavenly light.

verses.sa: विष्णोः क्रमोऽसि सपत्नहा गायत्रं छन्द आ रोह पृथिवीमनु वि क्रमस्व विष्णोः क्रमोऽस्यभिमातिहा त्रैष्टुभं छन्द आ रोहान्तरिक्षमनु वि क्रमस्व विष्णोः क्रमोऽस्यरातीयतो हन्ता जागतं छन्द आ रोह दिवमनु वि क्रमस्व विष्णोः क्रमोऽसि शत्रूयतो हन्ताऽऽनुष्टुभं छन्द आ रोह दिशोऽनु वि क्रमस्व॥
verses.tr: viṣṇoḥ kramo'si sapatnahā gāyatraṃ chanda ā roha pṛthivīmanu vi kramasva viṣṇoḥ kramo'syabhimātihā traiṣṭubhaṃ chanda ā rohāntarikṣamanu vi kramasva viṣṇoḥ kramo'syarātīyato hantā jāgataṃ chanda ā roha divamanu vi kramasva viṣṇoḥ kramo'si śatrūyato hantā''nuṣṭubhaṃ chanda ā roha diśo'nu vi kramasva
verses.en: Thou art the rival-slayiag stride of Vishnu. 'Mount the Gayatra metre: stride along the €earth. Thou art the foe destroying stride of Vishnu. Mount the Trishtup metre: stride along mid-air. Thou art the, traitor-slaying stride of Vishnu. Mount the Jagati metre: stride along the sky. Thou art the foeman-slaying stride of Vishnu. Mount Anushtup metre:. stride along the Quarters,

verses.sa: अक्रन्ददग्नि स्तनयन्निव द्यौः क्षामा रेरिहद्वीरुधः समञ्जन्। सद्यो जज्ञानो वि हीमिद्धो अख्यदा रोदसी भानुना भात्यन्तः॥
verses.tr: akrandadagni stanayanniva dyauḥ kṣāmā rerihadvīrudhaḥ samañjan sadyo jajñāno vi hīmiddho akhyadā rodasī bhānunā bhātyantaḥ
verses.en: Agni roared out like Dyaus what time he thunders: licking full oft the earth round plants he flickered. At once, when born, he looked about, enkindled: he shineth forth between the earth and heaven.

verses.sa: अग्नेऽभ्यावर्तिन्नभि मा नि वर्तस्वायुषा वर्चसा प्रजया धनेन। सन्या मेधया रय्या पोषेण॥
verses.tr: agne'bhyāvartinnabhi mā ni vartasvāyuṣā varcasā prajayā dhanena sanyā medhayā rayyā poṣeṇa
verses.en: Return to me, thou still-returning Agni, with life, with lustre, progeny, and treasure. With profit, wisdom, riches, and abundance.

verses.sa: अग्ने अङ्गिरः शतं ते सन्त्वावृतः सहस्रं त उपावृतः। अधा पोषस्य पोषेण पुनर्नो नष्टमा कृधि पुनर्नो रयिमा कृधि॥
verses.tr: agne aṅgiraḥ śataṃ te santvāvṛtaḥ sahasraṃ ta upāvṛtaḥ adhā poṣasya poṣeṇa punarno naṣṭamā kṛdhi punarno rayimā kṛdhi
verses.en: A hundred, Agni Angiras! be thy ways, a thousand thy returns. With increment of increase bring thou back to us what we have lost. Again bring hitherward our wealth.

verses.sa: पुनरूर्जा नि वर्तस्व पुनरग्न इषाऽऽयुषा। पुनर्नः पाह्यंहसः॥
verses.tr: punarūrjā ni vartasva punaragna iṣā''yuṣā punarnaḥ pāhyaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Return again with nourishment; Agni, aig&m with food and life. Again preserve us from distress.

verses.sa: सह रय्या नि वर्तस्वाग्ने पिन्वस्व धारया। विश्वप्स्न्या विश्वतस्परि॥
verses.tr: saha rayyā ni vartasvāgne pinvasva dhārayā viśvapsnyā viśvataspari
verses.en: Agni, return with store of wealth. Swell with thine overflowing stream that feedeth all on every side.

verses.sa: आ त्वाऽहार्षमन्तरभूर्ध्रुवस्तिष्ठाविचाचलिः। विशस्त्वा सर्वा वाञ्छन्तु मा त्वद्राष्ट्रमधिभ्रशत्॥
verses.tr: ā tvā'hārṣamantarabhūrdhruvastiṣṭhāvicācaliḥ viśastvā sarvā vāñchantu mā tvadrāṣṭramadhibhraśat
verses.en: I brought. thee: thou hast entered in. Stand stedfast and immovable. Let all the people long for thee. Let not thy kingship fall away.

verses.sa: उदुत्तमं वरुण पाशमस्मदवाधमं वि मध्यमं श्रथाय। अथा वयमादित्य व्रते तवानागसो अदितये स्याम॥
verses.tr: uduttamaṃ varuṇa pāśamasmadavādhamaṃ vi madhyamaṃ śrathāya athā vayamāditya vrate tavānāgaso aditaye syāma
verses.en: Varuna, from the upmost bond release us, let down the lowest and remove the midmost. So in thy holy law may we made sinless belong to Aditi, O thou Aditya.

verses.sa: अग्रे बृहन्नुषसामूर्ध्वो अस्थान्निर्जगन्वान् तमसो ज्योतिषाऽऽगात्। अग्निर्भानुना रुशता स्वङ्ग आ जातो विश्वा सद्मान्यप्राः॥
verses.tr: agre bṛhannuṣasāmūrdhvo asthānnirjaganvān tamaso jyotiṣā''gāt agnirbhānunā ruśatā svaṅga ā jāto viśvā sadmānyaprāḥ
verses.en: High hath the Mighty risen before the Mornings, and come to us with light from out the darkness. Fatr-shapen Agni with white-shining splendour hath filled at birth all human habitations.

verses.sa: हंसः शुचिषद्वसुरन्तरिक्षसद्धोता वेदिषदतिथिर्दूरोणसत्। नृषद्वरसदृतसद् व्योमसदब्जा गोजा ऋतजा अद्रिजा ऋतं बृहत्॥
verses.tr: haṃsaḥ śuciṣadvasurantarikṣasaddhotā vediṣadatithirdūroṇasat nṛṣadvarasadṛtasad vyomasadabjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtaṃ bṛhat
verses.en: The Hamsa homed in light, the Vasu in mid-air, the Priest beside the altar, Guest within the house, Dweller in noblest place, mid men, in truth, in sky, born of flood, kine, truth, mountain, he is holy Law. The Great.

verses.sa: सीद त्वं मातुरस्या उपस्थे विश्वान्यग्ने वयुनानि विद्वान्। मैनां तपसा मार्चिषाऽभि शोचीरन्तरस्यां शुक्रज्योतिर्वि भाहि॥
verses.tr: sīda tvaṃ māturasyā upasthe viśvānyagne vayunāni vidvān maināṃ tapasā mārciṣā'bhi śocīrantarasyāṃ śukrajyotirvi bhāhi
verses.en: Knowing all holy ordinances, Agni, be seated in the lap of this thy mother. Do not with heat or glowing flame consume her: shine thou within her with refulgent lustre.

verses.sa: अन्तरग्ने रुचा त्वमुखायाः सदने स्वे। तस्यास्त्वं हरसा तपञ्जातवेदः शिवो भव॥
verses.tr: antaragne rucā tvamukhāyāḥ sadane sve tasyāstvaṃ harasā tapañjātavedaḥ śivo bhava
verses.en: Within this Fire-pan with thy light, O Agni; in thy proper seat. Glowing with warmth, be gracious thou, O Jatavedas, unto her.

verses.sa: शिवो भूत्वा मह्यमग्ने अथो सीद शिवस्त्वम्। शिवाः कृत्वा दिशः सर्वाः स्वं योनिमिहासदः॥
verses.tr: śivo bhūtvā mahyamagne atho sīda śivastvam śivāḥ kṛtvā diśaḥ sarvāḥ svaṃ yonimihāsadaḥ
verses.en: Being propitious unto me, O.•'Agni, sit propitiously. Having made all the regions blest, in thine own dwelling seat thyself.

verses.sa: दिवस्परि प्रथमं जज्ञे अग्निरस्मद् द्वितीयं परि जातवेदाः। तृतीयमप्सु नृमणा अजस्रमिन्धान एनं जरते स्वाधीः॥
verses.tr: divaspari prathamaṃ jajñe agnirasmad dvitīyaṃ pari jātavedāḥ tṛtīyamapsu nṛmaṇā ajasramindhāna enaṃ jarate svādhīḥ
verses.en: First Agni sprang to life from out of heaven, the second time from os us came Jatavedas. Thirdly the Manly-souled was in the waters. The pious lauds and kindles him Eternal.

verses.sa: विद्मा ते अग्ने त्रेधा त्रयाणि विद्मा ते धाम विभृता पुरुत्रा। विद्मा ते नाम परमं गुहा यद्विद्मा तमुत्सं यत आजगन्थ॥
verses.tr: vidmā te agne tredhā trayāṇi vidmā te dhāma vibhṛtā purutrā vidmā te nāma paramaṃ guhā yadvidmā tamutsaṃ yata ājagantha
verses.en: Agni, we know thy three powers in three stations, we know thy forms, in many a place divided. We know what name supreme thou hast in secret: we know the source from which thou hast proceeded.

verses.sa: समुद्रे त्वा नृमणा अप्स्वन्तर्नृचक्षा ईधे दिवो अग्न ऊधन्। तृतीये त्वा रजसि तस्थिवांसमपामुपस्थे महिषा अवर्धन्॥
verses.tr: samudre tvā nṛmaṇā apsvantarnṛcakṣā īdhe divo agna ūdhan tṛtīye tvā rajasi tasthivāṃsamapāmupasthe mahiṣā avardhan
verses.en: The Manly-souled lit thee in sea and waters, Man's Viewer lit thee in the breast of heaven. There as thou stoodest in the third high region' the Bulls' increased thee in the waters' bosom.

verses.sa: अक्रन्ददग्नि स्तनयन्निव द्यौः क्षामा रेरिहद्वीरुधः समञ्जन्। सद्यो जज्ञानो वि हीमिद्धो अख्यदा रोदसी भानुना भात्यन्तः॥
verses.tr: akrandadagni stanayanniva dyauḥ kṣāmā rerihadvīrudhaḥ samañjan sadyo jajñāno vi hīmiddho akhyadā rodasī bhānunā bhātyantaḥ
verses.en: Agni roared out, etc. (verse repeated).

verses.sa: श्रीणामुदारो धरुणो रयीणां मनीषाणां प्रार्पणः सोमगोपाः। वसुः सूनुः सहसो अप्सु राजा वि भात्यग्र उषसामिधानः॥
verses.tr: śrīṇāmudāro dharuṇo rayīṇāṃ manīṣāṇāṃ prārpaṇaḥ somagopāḥ vasuḥ sūnuḥ sahaso apsu rājā vi bhātyagra uṣasāmidhānaḥ
verses.en: The spring of glories and support of riches, rouser of thoughts and guardian of the Soma, Good Son of Strength, a King amid the waters, in forefront of the Dawns he shines enkindled.

verses.sa: विश्वस्य केतुर्भुवनस्य गर्भ आ रोदसी अपृणाज्जायमानः। वीडुं चिदद्रिमभिनत् परायञ्जना यदग्निमयजन्त पञ्च॥
verses.tr: viśvasya keturbhuvanasya garbha ā rodasī apṛṇājjāyamānaḥ vīḍuṃ cidadrimabhinat parāyañjanā yadagnimayajanta pañca
verses.en: Germ of the world, ensign of all creation, he sprang to life and filled the earth and heaven. Even the firm rock he cleft when passing over, when the Five Tribes brought sacrifice to Agni.

verses.sa: उशिक्पावको अरतिः सुमेधा मर्त्येष्वग्निरमृतो नि धायि। इयर्ति धूममरुषं भरिभ्रदुच्छुक्रेण शोचिषा द्यामिनक्षन्॥
verses.tr: uśikpāvako aratiḥ sumedhā martyeṣvagniramṛto ni dhāyi iyarti dhūmamaruṣaṃ bharibhraducchukreṇa śociṣā dyāminakṣan
verses.en: So among mortals was immortal Agni stablished as cleansing, wise, and eager envoy. He waves the red smoke that he lifts above him, striving to reach the heaven with radiant lustre.

verses.sa: दृशानो रुक्म उर्व्या व्यद्यौद्दुर्मर्षमायुः श्रिये रुचानः। अग्निरमृतो अभवद्वयोभिर्यदेनं द्यौरजनयत्सुरेताः॥
verses.tr: dṛśāno rukma urvyā vyadyauddurmarṣamāyuḥ śriye rucānaḥ agniramṛto abhavadvayobhiryadenaṃ dyaurajanayatsuretāḥ
verses.en: Far hath he shone, etc. (verse I repeated).

verses.sa: यस्ते अद्य कृणवद्भद्रशोचेऽपूपं देव घृतवन्तमग्ने। प्र तं नय प्रतरं वस्यो अच्छाभि सुम्नं देवभक्तं यविष्ठ॥
verses.tr: yaste adya kṛṇavadbhadraśoce'pūpaṃ deva ghṛtavantamagne pra taṃ naya prataraṃ vasyo acchābhi sumnaṃ devabhaktaṃ yaviṣṭha
verses.en: Whoso this day, O God whose flames are lovely, makes thee a cake, O Agni, mixed with butter, Lead thou and.further him to higher fortune, to bliss be bestowed by Gods, O thou Most Youthful.

verses.sa: आ तं भज सौश्रवसेष्वग्न उक्थ उक्थ आ भज शस्यमाने। प्रियः सूर्ये प्रियो अग्ना भवात्युज्जातेन भिनददुज्जनित्वैः॥
verses.tr: ā taṃ bhaja sauśravaseṣvagna uktha uktha ā bhaja śasyamāne priyaḥ sūrye priyo agnā bhavātyujjātena bhinadadujjanitvaiḥ
verses.en: Endow him, Agni, with a share of glory, at. 'every song of praise sung forth enrich him. Dear let him be to SArya, dear to Agni, pre^miueut with son and children's children.

verses.sa: त्वामग्ने यजमाना अनु द्यून् विश्वा वसु दधिरे वार्याणि। त्वया सह द्रविणमिच्छमाना व्रजं गोमन्तमुशिजो वि वव्रुः॥
verses.tr: tvāmagne yajamānā anu dyūn viśvā vasu dadhire vāryāṇi tvayā saha draviṇamicchamānā vrajaṃ gomantamuśijo vi vavruḥ
verses.en: While, Agni, day by day men pay thee worship they win themselves all treasures worth the wishing. Allied with thee, eager and craving riches, they have disclosed the stable filled with cattle.

verses.sa: अस्ताव्यग्निर्नरां सुशेवो वैश्वानर ऋषिभिः सोमगोपाः। अद्वेषे द्यावापृथिवी हुवेम देवा धत्त रयिमस्मे सुवीरम्॥
verses.tr: astāvyagnirnarāṃ suśevo vaiśvānara ṛṣibhiḥ somagopāḥ adveṣe dyāvāpṛthivī huvema devā dhatta rayimasme suvīram
verses.en: Agni, man's gracious Friend, the Soma's keeper, Vai§vanara, hath been lauded by the Eishis. We will invoke benignant Earth and Heaven: ye Deities, give us wealth with hero children.

verses.sa: समिधाऽग्निं दुवस्यत घृतैर्बोधयतातिथिम्। आऽस्मिन् हव्या जुहोतन॥
verses.tr: samidhā'gniṃ duvasyata ghṛtairbodhayatātithim ā'smin havyā juhotana
verses.en: Pay service unto Agni with your fuel, rouse your Guest with oil: In him present your offerings.

verses.sa: उदु त्वा विश्वे देवा अग्ने भरन्तु चित्तिभिः। स नो भव शिवस्त्वं सुप्रतीको विभावसुः॥
verses.tr: udu tvā viśve devā agne bharantu cittibhiḥ sa no bhava śivastvaṃ supratīko vibhāvasuḥ
verses.en: May all the Gods, O Agni, bear thee upward with their earnest thoughts: Not to be looked on, rich in ip light, be thou propitious unto us.

verses.sa: प्रेदग्ने ज्योतिष्मान् याहि शिवेभिरर्चिभिष्ट्वम्। बृहद्भिर्भानुभिर्भासन्मा हिंसीस्तन्वा प्रजाः॥
verses.tr: predagne jyotiṣmān yāhi śivebhirarcibhiṣṭvam bṛhadbhirbhānubhirbhāsanmā hiṃsīstanvā prajāḥ
verses.en: Agni, go forth resplendent, thou with thine auspicious of fire. Shining' with mighty beams of light harm not my people with thy form.

verses.sa: अक्रन्ददग्नि स्तनयन्निव द्यौः क्षामा रेरिहद्वीरुधः समञ्जन्। सद्यो जज्ञानो वि हीमिद्धो अख्यदा रोदसी भानुना भात्यन्तः॥
verses.tr: akrandadagni stanayanniva dyauḥ kṣāmā rerihadvīrudhaḥ samañjan sadyo jajñāno vi hīmiddho akhyadā rodasī bhānunā bhātyantaḥ
verses.en: Agni roared out, etc. (verse repeated)

verses.sa: प्र-प्रायमग्निर्भरतस्य शृण्वे वि यत्सूर्यो न रोचते बृहद्भाः। अभि यः पूरुं पृतनासु तस्थौ दीदाय दैव्यो अतिथिः शिवो नः॥
verses.tr: pra-prāyamagnirbharatasya śṛṇve vi yatsūryo na rocate bṛhadbhāḥ abhi yaḥ pūruṃ pṛtanāsu tasthau dīdāya daivyo atithiḥ śivo naḥ
verses.en: Far famed is this the Bharata's own Agni: he shineth like the Sun with lofty splendour. He who hath vanquished Puru in the battle, the heavenly Guest hath shone for us benignly.

verses.sa: आपो देवीः प्रति गृभ्णीत भस्मैतत्स्योने कृणुध्वं सुरभा उ लोके। तस्मै नमन्तां जनयः सुपत्नीर्मातेव पुत्रं बिभृताप्स्वेनत्॥
verses.tr: āpo devīḥ prati gṛbhṇīta bhasmaitatsyone kṛṇudhvaṃ surabhā u loke tasmai namantāṃ janayaḥ supatnīrmāteva putraṃ bibhṛtāpsvenat
verses.en: Receive these ashes, ye celestial Waters, and lay them in! a fair place full of fragrance. To him bow down the nobly-wedded Matrons! I Bear this on waters as her son a mother.

verses.sa: अप्स्वग्ने सधिष्टव सौषधीरनु रुध्यसे। गर्भे सञ्जायसे पुनः॥
verses.tr: apsvagne sadhiṣṭava sauṣadhīranu rudhyase garbhe sañjāyase punaḥ
verses.en: Agni, thy home is In the floods: into the plants thou forcest way, And as their child art born anew.

verses.sa: गर्भो अस्योषधीनां गर्भो वनस्पतीनाम्। गर्भो विश्वस्य भूतस्याग्ने गर्भो अपामसि॥
verses.tr: garbho asyoṣadhīnāṃ garbho vanaspatīnām garbho viśvasya bhūtasyāgne garbho apāmasi
verses.en: Thou art the offspring of the plants, thou art the offspring of the trees: r The offspring thou of all that is, thou, Agni, art the Waters' Child.

verses.sa: प्रसद्य भस्मना योनिमपश्च पृथिवीमग्ने। संसृज्य मातृभिष्ट्वं ज्योतिष्मान् पुनरा ऽसदः॥
verses.tr: prasadya bhasmanā yonimapaśca pṛthivīmagne saṃsṛjya mātṛbhiṣṭvaṃ jyotiṣmān punarā 'sadaḥ
verses.en: With ashes having reached the womb, the waters, Agni! and the earth, United with the mothers, thou blazing hast seated thee again.

verses.sa: पुनरासद्य सदनमपश्च पृथिवीमग्ने। शेषे मातुर्यथोपस्थेऽन्तरस्यां शिवतमः॥
verses.tr: punarāsadya sadanamapaśca pṛthivīmagne śeṣe māturyathopasthe'ntarasyāṃ śivatamaḥ
verses.en: Seated again upon thy seat, the waters, Agni! I and the e earth. In her, thou, most auspicious One, liest as in a mother's: lap.

verses.sa: पुनरूर्जा नि वर्तस्व पुनरग्न इषाऽऽयुषा। पुनर्नः पाह्यंहसः॥ सह रय्या नि वर्तस्वाग्ने पिन्वस्व धारया। विश्वप्स्न्या विश्वतस्परि॥
verses.tr: punarūrjā ni vartasva punaragna iṣā''yuṣā punarnaḥ pāhyaṃhasaḥ saha rayyā ni vartasvāgne pinvasva dhārayā viśvapsnyā viśvataspari
verses.en: Return again, etc. Agni, return, etc. (verses and repeated).

verses.sa: बोधा मे अस्य वचसो यविष्ठ मंहिष्ठस्य प्रभृतस्य स्वधावः। पीयति त्वो अनु त्वो गृणाति वन्दारुष्टे तन्वं वन्दे अग्ने॥
verses.tr: bodhā me asya vacaso yaviṣṭha maṃhiṣṭhasya prabhṛtasya svadhāvaḥ pīyati tvo anu tvo gṛṇāti vandāruṣṭe tanvaṃ vande agne
verses.en: Mark this my speech, Divine One, thou Host Youthful, offered to by him who gives most freely: One hates thee, and another, sings thy praises. I thine adorer laud thy form, O Agni.

verses.sa: स बोधि सूरिर्मघवा वसुपते वसुदावन्। युयोध्यस्मद् द्वेषांसि विश्वकर्मणे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: sa bodhi sūrirmaghavā vasupate vasudāvan yuyodhyasmad dveṣāṃsi viśvakarmaṇe svāhā
verses.en: Be thou for us a liberal Prince, Giver aud and Lord of precious things. Drive those who hate us far away. To the Omutfic One All hail!

verses.sa: पुनस्त्वाऽऽदित्या रुद्रा वसवः समिन्धतां पुनर्ब्रह्माणो वसुनीथ यज्ञैः। घृतेन त्वं तन्वं वर्धयस्व सत्याः सन्तु यजमानस्य कामाः॥
verses.tr: punastvā''dityā rudrā vasavaḥ samindhatāṃ punarbrahmāṇo vasunītha yajñaiḥ ghṛtena tvaṃ tanvaṃ vardhayasva satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ
verses.en: Again let the Adityas, Rudras, Vasu?, and Brahmans With their rites light thee, Wealth-bringer! Increase thy body with presented butter: effectual be the Sacrificer's wishes.

verses.sa: अपेत वीत वि च सर्पतातो येऽत्र स्थ पुराणा ये च नूतनाः। अदाद्यमोऽवसानं पृथिव्या अक्रन्निमं पितरो लोकमस्मै॥
verses.tr: apeta vīta vi ca sarpatāto ye'tra stha purāṇā ye ca nūtanāḥ adādyamo'vasānaṃ pṛthivyā akrannimaṃ pitaro lokamasmai
verses.en: Go hence) depart, creep off in all directions, both ancient visitors and recent comers: Yama hath given a place on earth to rest in. This place for him the Fathers have provided.

verses.sa: संज्ञानमसि कामधरणं मयि ते कामधरणं भूयात्। अग्नेर्भस्मास्यग्नेः पुरीषमसि। चित स्थ परिचित ऊर्ध्वचितः श्रयध्वम्॥
verses.tr: saṃjñānamasi kāmadharaṇaṃ mayi te kāmadharaṇaṃ bhūyāt agnerbhasmāsyagneḥ purīṣamasi cita stha paricita ūrdhvacitaḥ śrayadhvam
verses.en: Knowledge art thou: accomplishment of wishes. In me be the fulfilment of thy wishes. Thou art the ashes, thou the mould of Agni. Rankers are ye, rankers around. Rankers right upward, be ye fixed.

verses.sa: अयं सो अग्निर्यस्मिन्त्सोममिन्द्रः सुतं दधे जठरे वावशानः। सहस्रियं वाजमत्यं न सप्तिं ससवान्त्सन्त्स्तूयसे जातवेदः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ so agniryasmintsomamindraḥ sutaṃ dadhe jaṭhare vāvaśānaḥ sahasriyaṃ vājamatyaṃ na saptiṃ sasavāntsantstūyase jātavedaḥ
verses.en: This is that Agni here the longing Indra took the pressed Soma deep within his body. Winner of spoils in thousands like a courser, with prayer art thou exalted, Jatavedas.

verses.sa: अग्ने यत्ते दिवि वर्चः पृथिव्यां यदोषधीष्वप्स्वा यजत्र। येनान्तरिक्षमुर्वाततन्थ त्वेषः स भानुरर्णवो नृचक्षाः॥
verses.tr: agne yatte divi varcaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yadoṣadhīṣvapsvā yajatra yenāntarikṣamurvātatantha tveṣaḥ sa bhānurarṇavo nṛcakṣāḥ
verses.en: The splendour which is thine in heaven, O Agni, in earth, O Holy One, in plants, in waters, Wherewith thou hast o'erspread mid-air's broad region, that light is brilliant, billowy, man-survey. ing.

verses.sa: अग्ने दिवो अर्णमच्छा जिगास्यच्छा देवाँ२ ऊचिषे धिष्ण्या ये। या रोचने परस्तात् सूर्यस्य याश्चावस्तादुपतिष्ठन्त आपः॥
verses.tr: agne divo arṇamacchā jigāsyacchā devāṃ2 ūciṣe dhiṣṇyā ye yā rocane parastāt sūryasya yāścāvastādupatiṣṭhanta āpaḥ
verses.en: O Agni, to the flood of heaven thou mountest, thou callest hither Gods, the thought-inspirers. The waters, those beyond the light of SArya, and those (that are beneath it here, approach thee.

verses.sa: पुरीष्यासो अग्नयः प्रावणेभिः सजोषसः। जुषन्तां यज्ञमद्रुहोऽनमीवा इषो महीः॥
verses.tr: purīṣyāso agnayaḥ prāvaṇebhiḥ sajoṣasaḥ juṣantāṃ yajñamadruho'namīvā iṣo mahīḥ
verses.en: May the Purishya Agnis in accord with those that spring from floods, May they, benevolent, accept the sacrifice, full, wholesome draughts.

verses.sa: इडामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध। स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे॥
verses.tr: iḍāmagne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha syānnaḥ sūnustanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatirbhūtvasme
verses.en: As holy food, Agni, to. thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels. To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward.

verses.sa: अयं ते योनिरृत्वियो यतो जातो अरोचथाः। तं जानन्नग्न आ रोहाथा नो वर्धया रयिम्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ te yonirṛtviyo yato jāto arocathāḥ taṃ jānannagna ā rohāthā no vardhayā rayim
verses.en: This is thine ordered place of birth whence, sprung to life, thou shonest forth. Knowing this, Agni, mount on high and cause our riches to increase.

verses.sa: चिदसि तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद परिचिदसि तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद॥
verses.tr: cidasi tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda paricidasi tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda
verses.en: Hanker art thou: Angiras-like sit steady with that Deity. Ranker-round art thou; Angiras-like sit steady with that Deity.

verses.sa: लोकं पृण छिद्रं पृणाथो सीद ध्रुवा त्वम्। इन्द्राग्नी त्वा बृहस्पतिरस्मिन् योनावसीषदन्॥
verses.tr: lokaṃ pṛṇa chidraṃ pṛṇātho sīda dhruvā tvam indrāgnī tvā bṛhaspatirasmin yonāvasīṣadan
verses.en: Fill up the room, supply the void, then settle steady in thy place. Indr-Agai and aud Brihaspati have set thee down in this abode.

verses.sa: ता अस्य सूददोहसः सोम श्रीणन्ति पृश्नयः। जन्मन्देवानां विशस्त्रिष्वा रोचने दिवः॥
verses.tr: tā asya sūdadohasaḥ soma śrīṇanti pṛśnayaḥ janmandevānāṃ viśastriṣvā rocane divaḥ
verses.en: The dappled kine who stream with milk prepare his draught of oma juice—Clans in the birthplace of the Gods, in the three luminous realms of heaven.

verses.sa: इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन्त्समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः। रथीतमं रथीनां वाजानां सत्पतिं पतिम्॥
verses.tr: indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhantsamudravyacasaṃ giraḥ rathītamaṃ rathīnāṃ vājānāṃ satpatiṃ patim
verses.en: All sacred songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea, The best of warriors borne on cars, the Lord, the very Lord of Strength.

verses.sa: समितं सं कल्पेथां संप्रियौ रोचिष्णू सुमनस्यमानौ। इषमूर्जमभि संवसानौ॥
verses.tr: samitaṃ saṃ kalpethāṃ saṃpriyau rociṣṇū sumanasyamānau iṣamūrjamabhi saṃvasānau
verses.en: Combine ye two and harmonize together, dear to each other, brilliant, friendly-minded. Abiding in one place for food and vigour.

verses.sa: सं वां मनांसि सं व्रता समु चित्तान्याकरम्। अग्ने पुरीष्याधिपा भव त्वं न इषमूर्जं यजमानाय धेहि॥
verses.tr: saṃ vāṃ manāṃsi saṃ vratā samu cittānyākaram agne purīṣyādhipā bhava tvaṃ na iṣamūrjaṃ yajamānāya dhehi
verses.en: Together have I brought your minds, your ordinances, and your thoughts. Be thou our Sovran Lord, Agni Purishya; give food and vigour to the Sacrificer.

verses.sa: अग्ने त्वं पुरीष्यो रयिमान् पुष्टिमाँ२ असि। शिवाः कृत्वा दिशः सर्वाः स्वं योनिमिहाऽसदः॥
verses.tr: agne tvaṃ purīṣyo rayimān puṣṭimāṃ2 asi śivāḥ kṛtvā diśaḥ sarvāḥ svaṃ yonimihā'sadaḥ
verses.en: Thou art Purishya Agni, thou art wealthy, thou art prosperous. Having made all the regions blest, here seat thee in thine own abode.

verses.sa: भवतं नः समनसौ सचेतसावरेपसौ। मा यज्ञं हिंसिष्टं मा यज्ञपतिं जातवेदसौ शिवौ भवतमद्य नः॥
verses.tr: bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau sacetasāvarepasau mā yajñaṃ hiṃsiṣṭaṃ mā yajñapatiṃ jātavedasau śivau bhavatamadya naḥ
verses.en: Be ye one-minded unto us, both of one thought, free from deceit. Harm not the 'sacrifice, harm not the Patron of the sacrifice. Be gracious unto us to-day, ye knowers of all things that be.

verses.sa: मातेव पुत्रं पृथिवी पुरीष्यमग्निं स्वे योनावभारुखा। तां विश्वैर्देवैरृतुभिः संविदानः प्रजापतिर्विश्वकर्मा वि मुञ्चतु॥
verses.tr: māteva putraṃ pṛthivī purīṣyamagniṃ sve yonāvabhārukhā tāṃ viśvairdevairṛtubhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ prajāpatirviśvakarmā vi muñcatu
verses.en: Even as a mother bears her son, Earth, Sukla hath borne within her womb Purishya Agni. Maker of all, accordant with the.All-Gods and Seasons, may PrajApati release her.

verses.sa: असुन्वन्तमयजमानमिच्छ स्तेनस्येत्यामन्विहि तस्करस्य। अन्यमस्मदिच्छ सा त इत्या नमो देवि निरृते तुभ्यमस्तु॥
verses.tr: asunvantamayajamānamiccha stenasyetyāmanvihi taskarasya anyamasmadiccha sā ta ityā namo devi nirṛte tubhyamastu
verses.en: Seek him who pours not, offers not oblation; follow the going of the thief and robber. This Tb-ia is thy way; j leave us and seek some other. To thee, O Goddess Nirriti, be homage.

verses.sa: नमः सु ते निरृते तिग्मतेजोऽयस्मयं वि चृता बन्धमेतम्। यमेन त्वं यम्या संविदानोत्तमे नाके अधि रोहयैनम्॥
verses.tr: namaḥ su te nirṛte tigmatejo'yasmayaṃ vi cṛtā bandhametam yamena tvaṃ yamyā saṃvidānottame nāke adhi rohayainam
verses.en: To thee, sharp-pointed Nirriti. full homage! I Loose and detach this iron bond that binds him. Unanimous with Yama and with Yarn} to the.sublimest vault of heaven uplift him.

verses.sa: यस्यास्ते घोर आसञ्जुहोम्येषां बन्धानामवसर्जनाय। यां त्वा जनो भूमिरिति प्रमन्दते निरृतिं त्वाऽहं परिवेद विश्वतः॥
verses.tr: yasyāste ghora āsañjuhomyeṣāṃ bandhānāmavasarjanāya yāṃ tvā jano bhūmiriti pramandate nirṛtiṃ tvā'haṃ pariveda viśvataḥ
verses.en: I Thou, Awful One, thou in whose mouth(I offer for the unloosing ot these of binding fetters, Whom people hail! as Earth with their glad voices, as Nirriti in every place I know thee.

verses.sa: यं ते देवी निरृतिराबबन्ध पाशं ग्रीवास्वविचृत्यम्। तं ते वि ष्याम्यायुषो न मध्यादथैतं पितुमद्धि प्रसूतः। नमो भूत्यै येदं चकार॥
verses.tr: yaṃ te devī nirṛtirābabandha pāśaṃ grīvāsvavicṛtyam taṃ te vi ṣyāmyāyuṣo na madhyādathaitaṃ pitumaddhi prasūtaḥ namo bhūtyai yedaṃ cakāra
verses.en: The binding noose which Nirriti the Goddess hath … fastened on thy neck that none may loose it, I loose for thee as from the midst of Ayus. Sped forward now, eat thou the food we offer. To Fortune, her who hath done this, be homage.

verses.sa: निवेशनः सङ्गमनो वसूनां विश्वा रूपाऽभि चष्टे शचीभिः। देव इव सविता सत्यधर्मेन्द्रो न तस्थौ समरे पथीनाम्॥
verses.tr: niveśanaḥ saṅgamano vasūnāṃ viśvā rūpā'bhi caṣṭe śacībhiḥ deva iva savitā satyadharmendro na tasthau samare pathīnām
verses.en: Establisher, the gatherer of treasures, he looks with might on every form and figure. Like Savitar the God whose laws are constant, like Indra he hath stood where meet the pathways.

verses.sa: सीरा युञ्जन्ति कवयो युगा वि तन्वते पृथक्। धीरा देवेषु सुम्नया॥
verses.tr: sīrā yuñjanti kavayo yugā vi tanvate pṛthak dhīrā deveṣu sumnayā
verses.en: Wise, through desire of bliss with Gods, the skilful bind the traces fast, and lay> the yokes on either side.

verses.sa: युनक्त सीरा वि युगा तनुध्वं कृते योनौ वपतेह बीजम्। गिरा च श्रुष्टिः सभरा असन्नो नेदीय इत्सृण्यः पक्वमेयात्॥
verses.tr: yunakta sīrā vi yugā tanudhvaṃ kṛte yonau vapateha bījam girā ca śruṣṭiḥ sabharā asanno nedīya itsṛṇyaḥ pakvameyāt
verses.en: Lay on the yokes and fasten well the traces: formed is the furrow, sow the seed within it. Through song may we find hearing fraught With plenty: near to the ripened grain approach the sickle.

verses.sa: शुनं सु फाला वि कृषन्तु भूमिं शुनं कीनाशा अभि यन्तु वाहैः। शुनासीरा हविषा तोशमाना सुपिप्पला ओषधीः कर्तनास्मै॥
verses.tr: śunaṃ su phālā vi kṛṣantu bhūmiṃ śunaṃ kīnāśā abhi yantu vāhaiḥ śunāsīrā haviṣā tośamānā supippalā oṣadhīḥ kartanāsmai
verses.en: Happily let the shares turn up the ploughland, happily go the ploughers with the oxen! §Suna and Sira, pleased, with our oar oblation, cause ye our plants to bear abundant fruitage.

verses.sa: घृतेन सीता मधुना समज्यतां विश्वैर्देवैरनुमता मरुद्भिः। ऊर्जस्वती पयसा पिन्वमानास्मान्त्सीते पयसाऽभ्या ववृत्स्व॥
verses.tr: ghṛtena sītā madhunā samajyatāṃ viśvairdevairanumatā marudbhiḥ ūrjasvatī payasā pinvamānāsmāntsīte payasā'bhyā vavṛtsva
verses.en: Approved by Visvedevas' and by Maruts, balmed be the furrow with sweet-flavoured fatness. Succulent, teeming with thy milky treasure, turn hitherward to us with milk, O Furrow.

verses.sa: लाङ्गलं पवीरवत्सुशेवं सोमपित्सरु। तदुद्वपति गामविं प्रफर्व्यं च पीवरीं प्रस्थावद्रथवाहणम्॥
verses.tr: lāṅgalaṃ pavīravatsuśevaṃ somapitsaru tadudvapati gāmaviṃ prapharvyaṃ ca pīvarīṃ prasthāvadrathavāhaṇam
verses.en: The keen-shared plough that bringeth bliss, good for the Soma-drinker's need, Shear out for' me a cow, a sheep, a 'rapid drawer of the car, a blooming woman, plump and strong! I

verses.sa: कामं कामदुघे धुक्ष्व मित्राय वरुणाय च। इन्द्रायाश्विभ्यां पूष्णे प्रजाभ्य ओषधीभ्यः॥
verses.tr: kāmaṃ kāmadughe dhukṣva mitrāya varuṇāya ca indrāyāśvibhyāṃ pūṣṇe prajābhya oṣadhībhyaḥ
verses.en: Milk out their wish, O Wishing-Cow, to Mitra and to Varuna, To ludra, to the Asvins, to PAshan, to people; aud to plants.

verses.sa: वि मुच्यध्वमघ्न्या देवयाना अगन्म तमसस्पारमस्य। ज्योतिरापाम॥
verses.tr: vi mucyadhvamaghnyā devayānā aganma tamasaspāramasya jyotirāpāma
verses.en: Be loosed; inviolable, God Godward-faivrs! We have attained the limit of this darkness: we have won the light.

verses.sa: सजूरब्दो अयवोभिः सजूरुषा अरुणीभिः। सजोषसावश्विना दंसोभिः सजूः सूर एतशेन सजूर्वैश्वानर इडया घृतेन स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: sajūrabdo ayavobhiḥ sajūruṣā aruṇībhiḥ sajoṣasāvaśvinā daṃsobhiḥ sajūḥ sūra etaśena sajūrvaiśvānara iḍayā ghṛtena svāhā
verses.en: The year together with the darksome fortnights; Dawn I^wu with the ruddy-coloured cows about her; the A$vins with their wonderful achievements; the Sun together' with his dappled Courser; Vbievauaea with I(}& and with, butter. Svaha!

verses.sa: या ओषधीः पूर्वा जाता देवेभ्यस्त्रियुगं पुरा। मनै नु बभ्रूणामहं शतं धामानि सप्त च॥
verses.tr: yā oṣadhīḥ pūrvā jātā devebhyastriyugaṃ purā manai nu babhrūṇāmahaṃ śataṃ dhāmāni sapta ca
verses.en: Herbs that sprang up in time of old, three ages earlier than the Gods,—., Of these, whose hue is brown, will I' declare the hundred powers and seven.

verses.sa: शतं वो अम्ब धामानि सहस्रमुत वो रुहः। अधा शतक्रत्वो यूयमिमं मे अगदं कृत॥
verses.tr: śataṃ vo amba dhāmāni sahasramuta vo ruhaḥ adhā śatakratvo yūyamimaṃ me agadaṃ kṛta
verses.en: Ye, Mothers, have a hundred homes, yea, and a thousand' are your growths. Do ye who have a thousand powers free this my patient from disease.

verses.sa: ओषधीः प्रति मोदध्वं पुष्पवतीः प्रसूवरीः। अश्वा इव सजित्वरीर्वीरुधः पारयिष्ण्वः॥
verses.tr: oṣadhīḥ prati modadhvaṃ puṣpavatīḥ prasūvarīḥ aśvā iva sajitvarīrvīrudhaḥ pārayiṣṇvaḥ
verses.en: Be glad and joyful in the Plants, both blossoming and bearing fruit, Plants that will lead us to success like mares who conquer in the race.

verses.sa: ओषधीरिति मातरस्तद्वो देवीरुप ब्रुवे। सनेयमश्वं गां वास आत्मानं तव पूरुष॥
verses.tr: oṣadhīriti mātarastadvo devīrupa bruve saneyamaśvaṃ gāṃ vāsa ātmānaṃ tava pūruṣa
verses.en: Plants, by this name I speak to you, Mothers, to you the Goddesses: Steed, cow, and garment may I win, win back thy very self,, man.

verses.sa: अश्वत्थे वो निषदनं पर्णे वो वसतिष्कृता। गोभाज इत्किलासथ यत्सनवथ पूरुषम्॥
verses.tr: aśvatthe vo niṣadanaṃ parṇe vo vasatiṣkṛtā gobhāja itkilāsatha yatsanavatha pūruṣam
verses.en: The Holy Fig tree is your home, your mansion is the Parna tree: i Winners of cattle shall ye be if ye regain for me this man.

verses.sa: यत्रौषधीः समग्मत राजानः समिताविव। विप्रः स उच्यते भिषग्रक्षोहामीवचातनः॥
verses.tr: yatrauṣadhīḥ samagmata rājānaḥ samitāviva vipraḥ sa ucyate bhiṣagrakṣohāmīvacātanaḥ
verses.en: He who hath store of Herbs at hand like Kings amid a crowd of men,—Physician is that sage's, name, bend slayer, chaser of disease.

verses.sa: अश्वावतीं सोमावतीमूर्जयन्तीमुदोजसम्। आऽवित्सि सर्वा ओषधीरस्मा अरिष्टतातये॥
verses.tr: aśvāvatīṃ somāvatīmūrjayantīmudojasam ā'vitsi sarvā oṣadhīrasmā ariṣṭatātaye
verses.en: Herbs rich in Soma, rich in steeds, in nourishment, in strengthening power,—All these have I provided here, that this man may be whole again.

verses.sa: उच्छुष्मा ओषधीनां गावो गोष्ठादिवेरते। धनं सनिष्यन्तीनामात्मानं तव पूरुष॥
verses.tr: ucchuṣmā oṣadhīnāṃ gāvo goṣṭhādiverate dhanaṃ saniṣyantīnāmātmānaṃ tava pūruṣa
verses.en: The healing virtues of the Plants stream forth like cattle from the stall,—Plants that shall win me store of wealth, and save thy vital breath, O man.

verses.sa: इष्कृतिर्नाम वो माताऽथो यूयं स्थ निष्कृतीः। सीराः पतत्रिणी स्थन यदामयति निष्कृथ॥
verses.tr: iṣkṛtirnāma vo mātā'tho yūyaṃ stha niṣkṛtīḥ sīrāḥ patatriṇī sthana yadāmayati niṣkṛtha
verses.en: Reliever is your' mother's name, and hence Restorers are ye called. Rivers are ye with wings that fly: keep far whatever brings disease.

verses.sa: अति विश्वाः परिष्ठा स्तेन इव व्रजमक्रमुः। ओषधीः प्राचुच्यवुर्यत्किं च तन्वो रपः॥
verses.tr: ati viśvāḥ pariṣṭhā stena iva vrajamakramuḥ oṣadhīḥ prācucyavuryatkiṃ ca tanvo rapaḥ
verses.en: Over all fences have they passed, as steals a thief into the fold. The Plants have driven from the frame whatever malady was there.

verses.sa: यदिमा वाजयन्नहमोषधीर्हस्त आदधे। आत्मा यक्ष्मस्य नश्यति पुरा जीवगृभो यथा॥
verses.tr: yadimā vājayannahamoṣadhīrhasta ādadhe ātmā yakṣmasya naśyati purā jīvagṛbho yathā
verses.en: When, bringing back the vanished strength, I hold these herbs within my hand, The spirit of disease departs ere he can seize upon the life.

verses.sa: यस्यौषधीः प्रसर्पथाङ्गमङ्गं परुष्परुः। ततो यक्ष्मं वि बाधध्व उग्रो मध्यमशीरिव॥
verses.tr: yasyauṣadhīḥ prasarpathāṅgamaṅgaṃ paruṣparuḥ tato yakṣmaṃ vi bādhadhva ugro madhyamaśīriva
verses.en: He through whose frame, vO Plants, ye creep member by member, joint by joint,—From him ye drive away disease like some strong arbiter of strife.'

verses.sa: साकं यक्ष्म प्र पत चाषेण किकिदीविना। साकं वातस्य ध्राज्या साकं नश्य निहाकया॥
verses.tr: sākaṃ yakṣma pra pata cāṣeṇa kikidīvinā sākaṃ vātasya dhrājyā sākaṃ naśya nihākayā
verses.en: Fly, Spirit of Disease, begone, with the blue jay and king. Fly, with the wind impetuous speed, vanish together with the storm.

verses.sa: अन्या वो अन्यामवत्वन्यान्यस्या उपावत। ताः सर्वाः संविदाना इदं मे प्रावता वचः॥
verses.tr: anyā vo anyāmavatvanyānyasyā upāvata tāḥ sarvāḥ saṃvidānā idaṃ me prāvatā vacaḥ
verses.en: Help every one the other, lend assistance each of you to each, All of you be accordant, give furtherance to this speech of mine.

verses.sa: याः फलिनीर्या अफला अपुष्पा याश्च पुष्पिणीः। बृहस्पतिप्रसूतास्ता नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yāḥ phalinīryā aphalā apuṣpā yāśca puṣpiṇīḥ bṛhaspatiprasūtāstā no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Let fruitful Plants, and fruitless, those that blossom, and the blossomless, Urged onward by Brihaspati, release us from our pain and grief;

verses.sa: मुञ्चन्तु मा शपथ्यादथो वरुण्यादुत। अथो यमस्य पड्वीशात्सर्वस्माद्देवकिल्बिषात्॥
verses.tr: muñcantu mā śapathyādatho varuṇyāduta atho yamasya paḍvīśātsarvasmāddevakilbiṣāt
verses.en: Realese me from the curse's plague and woe that comes from Aruna; Free me from Yama's fetter, from sin and offence against the Gods.

verses.sa: अवपतन्तीरवदन्दिव ओषधयस्परि। यं जीवमश्नवामहै न स रिष्याति पूरुषः॥
verses.tr: avapatantīravadandiva oṣadhayaspari yaṃ jīvamaśnavāmahai na sa riṣyāti pūruṣaḥ
verses.en: What time, descending from the sky, the Plants flew earth-ward, thus they spake: No evil shall befall the man whom while he liveth we pervade.

verses.sa: या ओषधीः सोमराज्ञीर्बह्वीः शतविचक्षणाः। तासामसि त्वमुत्तमारं कामाय शं हृदे॥
verses.tr: yā oṣadhīḥ somarājñīrbahvīḥ śatavicakṣaṇāḥ tāsāmasi tvamuttamāraṃ kāmāya śaṃ hṛde
verses.en: Of all the many Plants whose King is Soma, Plants of hundred forms, Thou art the Plant most excellent, prompt to the wish, sweet to the heart.

verses.sa: या ओषधीः सोमराज्ञीर्विष्ठिताः पृथिवीमनु। बृहस्पतिप्रसूता अस्यै संदत्त वीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: yā oṣadhīḥ somarājñīrviṣṭhitāḥ pṛthivīmanu bṛhaspatiprasūtā asyai saṃdatta vīryam
verses.en: O all ye various Herbs whose King is Soma, that o'erspread the earth, Urged onward by Brihaspati, combine your virtue in this Plant.

verses.sa: याश्चेदमुपशृण्वन्ति याश्च दूरं परागताः। सर्वाः संगत्य वीरुधोऽस्यै संदत्त वीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: yāścedamupaśṛṇvanti yāśca dūraṃ parāgatāḥ sarvāḥ saṃgatya vīrudho'syai saṃdatta vīryam
verses.en: All Plants that hear this speech, and those that have departed far away, Come all assembled and confer your healing power upon this Herb.

verses.sa: मा वो रिषत् खनिता यस्मै चाहं खनामि वः। द्विपाच्चतुष्पादस्माकं सर्वमस्त्वनातुरम्॥
verses.tr: mā vo riṣat khanitā yasmai cāhaṃ khanāmi vaḥ dvipāccatuṣpādasmākaṃ sarvamastvanāturam
verses.en: Unharmed be he who digs you up, unharmed the man for whom I dig: And let no malady attack biped or quadruped of ours.

verses.sa: ओषधयः समवदन्त सोमेन सह राज्ञा। यस्मै कृणोति ब्राह्मणस्तं राजन् पारयामसि॥
verses.tr: oṣadhayaḥ samavadanta somena saha rājñā yasmai kṛṇoti brāhmaṇastaṃ rājan pārayāmasi
verses.en: With Soma as their Sovran Lord the Plants hold colloquy and say: O: King, we.save death the man whose cure a Brfthman undertakes.

verses.sa: नाशयित्री बलासस्यार्शस उपचितामसि। अथो शतस्य यक्ष्माणां पाकारोरसि नाशनी॥
verses.tr: nāśayitrī balāsasyārśasa upacitāmasi atho śatasya yakṣmāṇāṃ pākārorasi nāśanī
verses.en: Most excellent of all art thou, O Plant: thy vassals are the trees. Let him be subject to our power, the man who seeks to injure us.

verses.sa: त्वां गन्धर्वा अखनँस्त्वामिन्द्रस्त्वां बृहस्पतिः। त्वामोषधे सोमो राजा विद्वान् यक्ष्मादमुच्यत॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ gandharvā akhanaṃstvāmindrastvāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ tvāmoṣadhe somo rājā vidvān yakṣmādamucyata
verses.en: Banisher of catarrh art thou, of tumours and of hemorrhoids; holds; Thou banishest Pik^ru and Consumption in a hundred forms.

verses.sa: सहस्व मे अरातीः सहस्व पृतनायतः। सहस्व सर्वं पाप्मानं सहमानास्योषधे॥
verses.tr: sahasva me arātīḥ sahasva pṛtanāyataḥ sahasva sarvaṃ pāpmānaṃ sahamānāsyoṣadhe
verses.en: Thee did Gandharvas dig from earth, thee Indra and Brihaspati. King Soma, knowing thee, O Plant, from his Consuipption was made free.

verses.sa: दीर्घायुस्त ओषधे खनिता यस्मै च त्वा खनाम्यहम्। अथो त्वं दीर्घायुर्भूत्वा शतवल्शा विरोहतात्॥
verses.tr: dīrghāyusta oṣadhe khanitā yasmai ca tvā khanāmyaham atho tvaṃ dīrghāyurbhūtvā śatavalśā virohatāt
verses.en: Conquer mine enemies, the men who challenge.me do de thou subdue. Conquer thou all unhappiness: victorious art thou, O Plant.

verses.sa: त्वमुत्तमास्योषधे तव वृक्षा उपस्तयः। उपस्तिरस्तु सोऽस्माकं यो अस्माँ२ अभिदासति॥
verses.tr: tvamuttamāsyoṣadhe tava vṛkṣā upastayaḥ upastirastu so'smākaṃ yo asmāṃ2 abhidāsati
verses.en: Long-lived be he who digs thee, Plant, and be for whom I dig thee up. So mayst thou also, grown lived, rise upward with i hundred shoots.

verses.sa: मा मा हिंसीज्जनिता यः पृथिव्या यो वा दिवं सत्यधर्मा व्यानट्। यश्चापश्चन्द्राः प्रथमो जजान कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: mā mā hiṃsījjanitā yaḥ pṛthivyā yo vā divaṃ satyadharmā vyānaṭ yaścāpaścandrāḥ prathamo jajāna kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: Most excellent of.<all art thou, O Plant; thy vassals are the trees. Let him be subject to our power, the man who seeks to injure us.

verses.sa: अभ्या वर्तस्व पृथिवि यज्ञेन पयसा सह। वपां ते अग्निरिषितो अरोहत्॥
verses.tr: abhyā vartasva pṛthivi yajñena payasā saha vapāṃ te agniriṣito arohat
verses.en: May he not harm me who is earth's begetter, nor he whose laws are faithful, sky's pervader; Nor be who first begot the lucid waters. To Ka the God let us present oblation.

verses.sa: अग्ने यत्ते शुक्रं यच्चन्द्रं यत्पूतं यच्च यज्ञियम्। तद्देवेभ्यो भरामसि॥
verses.tr: agne yatte śukraṃ yaccandraṃ yatpūtaṃ yacca yajñiyam taddevebhyo bharāmasi
verses.en: Turn thyself hitherward, O Earth, to us with sacrifice and milk. Thy covering skin Agni, urged forth, hath mounted.-

verses.sa: इषमूर्जमहमित आदमृतस्य योनिं महिषस्य धाराम्। आ मा गोषु विशत्वा तनूषु जहामि सेदिमनिराममीवाम्॥
verses.tr: iṣamūrjamahamita ādamṛtasya yoniṃ mahiṣasya dhārām ā mā goṣu viśatvā tanūṣu jahāmi sedimanirāmamīvām
verses.en: All, Agni, that m in thee is bright, pure, cleansed, and meet for sacrifice. That do we bring unto the Gods.

verses.sa: अग्ने तव श्रवो वयो महि भ्राजन्ते अर्चयो विभावसो। बृहद्भानो शवसा वाजमुक्थ्यं दधासि दाशुषे कवे॥
verses.tr: agne tava śravo vayo mahi bhrājante arcayo vibhāvaso bṛhadbhāno śavasā vājamukthyaṃ dadhāsi dāśuṣe kave
verses.en: I from this place have fed on strength and vigour, the womb) of holy Law, stream of the mighty. In cows let it possess me and in bodies. I quite decline and lack of food, and sickness.

verses.sa: पावकवर्चाः शुक्रवर्चा अनूनवर्चा उदियर्षि भानुना। पुत्रो मातरा विचरन्नुपावसि पृणक्षि रोदसी उभे॥
verses.tr: pāvakavarcāḥ śukravarcā anūnavarcā udiyarṣi bhānunā putro mātarā vicarannupāvasi pṛṇakṣi rodasī ubhe
verses.en: Agni, life-power and fame are thine: thy fires blaze mightily, thou rich in wealth of beams! I Sage, passing bright, thou givest to the worshipper,, with strength, the food that merits laud.

verses.sa: ऊर्जो नपाज्जातवेदः सुशस्तिभिर्मन्दस्व धीतिभिर्हितः। त्वे इषः सन्दधुर्भूरिवर्पसश्चित्रोतयो वामजाताः॥
verses.tr: ūrjo napājjātavedaḥ suśastibhirmandasva dhītibhirhitaḥ tve iṣaḥ sandadhurbhūrivarpasaścitrotayo vāmajātāḥ
verses.en: With brilliant, purifying sheen, with perfect sheen thou liftest up thyself in light. Thou; visiting both thy Mothers, aidest them as Son: thou joinest close the earth and heaven.

verses.sa: इरज्यन्नग्ने प्रथयस्व जन्तुभिरस्मे रायो अमर्त्य। स दर्शतस्य वपुषो वि राजसि पृणक्षि सानसिं क्रतुम्॥
verses.tr: irajyannagne prathayasva jantubhirasme rāyo amartya sa darśatasya vapuṣo vi rājasi pṛṇakṣi sānasiṃ kratum
verses.en: O 'Jatavedas, Son of Strength, rejoice thyself, gracious, in our fair hymns and songs. In thee are treasured various forms of strengthening food, born nobly and of wondrous help.

verses.sa: इष्कर्तारमध्वरस्य प्रचेतसं क्षयन्तं राधसो महः। रातिं वामस्य सुभगां महीमिषं दधासि सानसिं रयिम्॥
verses.tr: iṣkartāramadhvarasya pracetasaṃ kṣayantaṃ rādhaso mahaḥ rātiṃ vāmasya subhagāṃ mahīmiṣaṃ dadhāsi sānasiṃ rayim
verses.en: Agni, spread forth, as Ruler, over living things: give wealth to us, Immortal God. Thou shinest out from beauty fair to look upon: thou leadest us to conquering power.

verses.sa: ऋतावानं महिषं विश्वदर्शतमग्निं सुम्नाय दधिरे पुरो जनाः। श्रुत्कर्णं सप्रथस्तमं त्वा गिरा दैव्यं मानुषा युगा॥
verses.tr: ṛtāvānaṃ mahiṣaṃ viśvadarśatamagniṃ sumnāya dadhire puro janāḥ śrutkarṇaṃ saprathastamaṃ tvā girā daivyaṃ mānuṣā yugā
verses.en: To him, the wise, who orders sacrifice, who hath great riches under his control, Thou givest blest award of good, and plenteous food, givest him wealth that conquers all.

verses.sa: आ प्यायस्व समेतु ते विश्वतः सोम वृष्ण्यम्। भवा वाजस्य सङ्गथे॥
verses.tr: ā pyāyasva sametu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam bhavā vājasya saṅgathe
verses.en: The men have set before them for their welfare Agni, strong, visible to all, the Holy. Thee, Godlike One, with ears to hear, most famous, men's generations magnify with praise. songs

verses.sa: सं ते पयांसि समु यन्तु वाजाः सं वृष्ण्यान्यभिमातिषाहः। आप्यायमानो अमृताय सोम दिवि श्रवांस्युत्तमानि धिष्व॥
verses.tr: saṃ te payāṃsi samu yantu vājāḥ saṃ vṛṣṇyānyabhimātiṣāhaḥ āpyāyamāno amṛtāya soma divi śravāṃsyuttamāni dhiṣva
verses.en: Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee. Be in the gathering-place of strength.

verses.sa: आ प्यायस्व मदिन्तम सोम विश्वेभिरंशुभिः। भवा नः सप्रथस्तमः सखा वृधे॥
verses.tr: ā pyāyasva madintama soma viśvebhiraṃśubhiḥ bhavā naḥ saprathastamaḥ sakhā vṛdhe
verses.en: In thee be juicy nutriments united, and power and mighty foe-subduing vigour. Waxing to immortality, O Soma, win highest glory for thyself in heaven.

verses.sa: आ ते वत्सो मनो यमत्परमाच्चित्सधस्थात्। अग्ने त्वाङ्कामया गिरा॥
verses.tr: ā te vatso mano yamatparamāccitsadhasthāt agne tvāṅkāmayā girā
verses.en: Wax, O most gladdening Soma, great through all thy filaments, and be. A friend of most illustrious fame to prosper us.

verses.sa: तुभ्यं ता अङ्गिरस्तम विश्वाः सुक्षितयः पृथक्। अग्ने कामाय येमिरे॥
verses.tr: tubhyaṃ tā aṅgirastama viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthak agne kāmāya yemire
verses.en: May Vatsa draw thy mind away, even from thy loftiest dwelling-place, Agni, with song that yearns for thee.

verses.sa: अग्निः प्रियेषु धामसु कामो भूतस्य भव्यस्य। सम्राडेको वि राजति॥
verses.tr: agniḥ priyeṣu dhāmasu kāmo bhūtasya bhavyasya samrāḍeko vi rājati
verses.en: Agni, best Angiras, to thee all people who have pleasant homes. Apart fiave turned to gain their wish.
In dear homes, Agni, the desire of all that is and is to be, Shines forth the One Imperial Lord.
